overall: Los Angeles is running warmer than expected on Independence Day, with the current temperature and running maximum already reaching 75.2°F as of 17:40 ET — well above the NWS daytime high forecast of 73°F. Temperatures have been climbing steadily through the afternoon, and a positive velocity of +1.1°F/hr along with positive acceleration suggests the day has not yet fully peaked. The marine influence with westerly winds around 10 mph and dewpoints near 61°F is providing some moisture but not enough to cap the warming seen so far.
